areas.title: The audio chain: being heard and hearing
Crashes and performance, on web and native
Entry: dashboard, invite, admission, prejoin, embed and boot
Join and media connection, including listen-only
Platform: DB, releases, flags, Cloudflare edge
Report a problem and live introspection
Kernel self-tests. Test-only: never emitted in production, and left out of the Axiom schema and the CLI tables.

fields.name: acquire_count
fields.doc: Delta of cumulative pool Acquire calls since the previous sample.

fields.name: acquired_conns
fields.doc: Pool connections checked out at this sample.

fields.name: active_backends
fields.doc: pg_stat_activity sessions for application_name chalk-api in state active at this sample.

fields.name: admission_request_id
fields.doc: The admission request.

fields.name: agent_id
fields.doc: The tenant's identifier for the agent.

fields.name: app_build
fields.doc: The host app's build number.

fields.name: app_version
fields.doc: The host app's version.

fields.name: attempt
fields.doc: Which run of a job or which try of an op this is, starting at 1.

fields.name: banner_kind
fields.doc: Which self-test banner.

fields.name: batch_id
fields.doc: The batch that delivered the record. Stamped by the batcher or the ingest, not by the kernel.

fields.name: blocker_application_name
fields.doc: application_name of the session blocking the oldest chalk-api Lock waiter, when the role may see it.

fields.name: blocker_usename
fields.doc: usename of the session blocking the oldest chalk-api Lock waiter, when the role may see it.

fields.name: blocker_xact_age_ms
fields.doc: Age in milliseconds of the blocking session's transaction.

fields.name: bucket_start_ms
fields.doc: Unix milliseconds a five-minute UTC edge rollup bucket begins.

fields.name: bytes
fields.doc: Response body bytes on an api.http_request row.

fields.name: canceled_acquire_count
fields.doc: Delta of acquires canceled while waiting since the previous sample.

fields.name: chalk_alert_reason
fields.doc: A collector row's machine-readable reason, such as healthy, api_unhealthy or tunnel_unhealthy.

fields.name: chalk_alert_rule
fields.doc: The alert rule name a production-state collector row was written under.

fields.name: chalk_alert_stream
fields.doc: The collector stream a production-state row belongs to.

fields.name: chalk_alert_value
fields.doc: A collector row's measured value; for database-unreachable and runtime-health 1 is unhealthy and 0 is healthy.

fields.name: changed_at_ms
fields.doc: Unix milliseconds a media_plane_changes row was recorded.

fields.name: client_mono_ms
fields.doc: The client's monotonic clock, since its time origin.

fields.name: client_session_id
fields.doc: The SDK client session: one client object's lifetime. The client kernel stamps it on every record, separate from source_id, because one client session opens a new source for each Participant it joins as.

fields.name: client_wall_ms
fields.doc: The client's wall clock, in Unix milliseconds.

fields.name: clock_epoch
fields.doc: Counts clock jumps in this source. Records from different epochs are ordered only by seq.

fields.name: clock_err_ms
fields.doc: The bound on est_server_ms's error. Absent on server records.

fields.name: clock_state
fields.doc: Whether est_server_ms can be trusted.

fields.name: commit
fields.doc: The source revision a release marker deploys, or unavailable(pages_rollback) when a Pages rollback cannot name one.

fields.name: component
fields.doc: The deployable a release marker describes: api, sync, web, recorder or an infrastructure stack name.

fields.name: constructing_conns
fields.doc: Pool connections being built at this sample.

fields.name: content_class
fields.doc: Whether the edge response content type was text/html.

fields.name: db_reach
fields.doc: The reachability claim compared across witnesses: down when the sample could not reach Postgres, up when it could; the host collector's chalk_alert_value projects to the same vocabulary.

fields.name: db_status
fields.doc: Whether the health poller's dedicated connection could open or ping Postgres in this sample.

fields.name: decision
fields.doc: What a decision decided, from the event's declared values.

fields.name: decision_id
fields.doc: The decision.

fields.name: device_ephemeral
fields.doc: True when device_id could not be stored and lives only for this client session.

fields.name: device_id
fields.doc: The persistent device.

fields.name: drop_reason
fields.doc: On a drop record (C3): why the client gave up on the seqs in dropped_seqs.

fields.name: dropped_seqs
fields.doc: On a drop record (C3): the half-open seq ranges [from, to) of the record's own source that the client gave up on, all below the record's seq, at most 64.

fields.name: duration_ms
fields.doc: An op's duration, or how long a state lasted.

fields.name: edge_status
fields.doc: The HTTP status Cloudflare answered the client with.

fields.name: empty_acquire_count
fields.doc: Delta of acquires that waited for a connection since the previous sample.

fields.name: empty_acquire_wait_ms
fields.doc: Delta of cumulative milliseconds waited for an empty pool since the previous sample.

fields.name: end
fields.doc: How a source ended (C3), on the batch that reports it: closed (the client said its last next_seq exactly) or abandoned (the next page load found it dead and reports the last high-water mark it persisted). The ledger refuses an end below a seq it settled or below a next_seq already reported, so the missing suffix stays a gap.

fields.name: end_reason
fields.doc: Why a call or an Episode ended. The server and the client use different values, so each event narrows the list.

fields.name: env
fields.doc: The environment.

fields.name: episode_id
fields.doc: The Episode.

fields.name: error_code
fields.doc: A fixed error code on a request log row, never a raw error string.

fields.name: est_server_ms
fields.doc: The estimated server time in Unix milliseconds. A server stamps its own clock.

fields.name: event_id
fields.doc: One record. Minted by the kernel when the record is made.

fields.name: finished_ms
fields.doc: Unix milliseconds when a deploy or rollback attempt finished.

fields.name: flags
fields.doc: The full flags map: config switches, the media-plane kill switch and caps. Never credentials.

fields.name: flags_hash
fields.doc: 16 hex characters of the SHA-256 of the canonical flags JSON. Resolve it with the obs.flags_snapshot fact that carries the same hash.

fields.name: from_state
fields.doc: The state before a transition.

fields.name: generation
fields.doc: Which join of the Participant seat this is.

fields.name: host
fields.doc: The hostname the edge served requests for.

fields.name: host_boot_id
fields.doc: The host's identifier for this process boot, supplied by the environment.

fields.name: http_status
fields.doc: The HTTP status an uptime probe received, or 0 when the fetch threw.

fields.name: idle_conns
fields.doc: Pool connections idle at this sample.

fields.name: idle_in_tx_backends
fields.doc: pg_stat_activity sessions for application_name chalk-api idle in transaction at this sample.

fields.name: item_count
fields.doc: How many items a self-test op handled.

fields.name: job_id
fields.doc: The background job.

fields.name: journey_id
fields.doc: The user-visible attempt this record belongs to.

fields.name: jump_ms
fields.doc: How far the wall clock stepped against the monotonic clock.

fields.name: kind
fields.doc: op, transition, decision, surface or fact.

fields.name: lock_status
fields.doc: Whether the pg_stat_activity and pg_blocking_pids read inside this sample succeeded.

fields.name: lock_waiters
fields.doc: chalk-api backends with wait_event_type Lock at this sample.

fields.name: machine
fields.doc: A transition's machine.

fields.name: marker_kind
fields.doc: What the release marker records: a deploy, an operator or automatic rollback, or a failed deploy attempt.

fields.name: max_conns
fields.doc: pgxpool MaxConns at this sample.

fields.name: max_lock_wait_ms
fields.doc: Longest milliseconds a chalk-api Lock waiter has been waiting, measured from its query_start.

fields.name: media_connection_id
fields.doc: Chalk's media connection.

fields.name: media_plane_scope
fields.doc: The scope a media-plane change applies to.

fields.name: method
fields.doc: An HTTP method token.

fields.name: module
fields.doc: The emitting program.

fields.name: name
fields.doc: The registry event name. A transition's name is its machine.

fields.name: new_plane
fields.doc: The media plane a media_plane_changes row moved to.

fields.name: next_seq
fields.doc: The source's high-water mark on every batch (C3): every seq below it has been assigned.

fields.name: note_kind
fields.doc: Which self-test note.

fields.name: old_plane
fields.doc: The media plane a media_plane_changes row moved away from.

fields.name: op_id
fields.doc: The op.

fields.name: origin_reach
fields.doc: The origin claim compared across witnesses: down when an uptime probe failed or could not fetch, up when the target answered; the host collector's chalk_alert_value projects to the same vocabulary.

fields.name: origin_status
fields.doc: The HTTP status the origin answered Cloudflare with, or 0 when the origin could not be reached.

fields.name: outcome
fields.doc: An op's terminal outcome.

fields.name: parent_op_id
fields.doc: The op that started this one.

fields.name: participant_id
fields.doc: The Participant seat in the Episode.

fields.name: path
fields.doc: The request URL path on an api.http_request row; the route carries the cardinality-safe shape.

fields.name: path_class
fields.doc: The request-path class an edge rollup counts: static assets, health probes, Space pages or the rest.

fields.name: platform
fields.doc: Where the program runs.

fields.name: previous_boot_end
fields.doc: How the host says the previous boot of this service ended, supplied by the environment.

fields.name: provider_media_id
fields.doc: The media provider's session id.

fields.name: reason_code
fields.doc: A registry reason code. Required when the outcome is expected or error, and on a decision that refuses, times out, closes or limits.

fields.name: recording_id
fields.doc: The recording.

fields.name: release_id
fields.doc: The immutable release identifier the deployment controller or Pages produced and services report as their version.

fields.name: release_sha
fields.doc: The git commit the program was built from.

fields.name: request_id
fields.doc: The request attempt.

fields.name: requests
fields.doc: Requests one edge rollup row counted.

fields.name: route
fields.doc: The matched API route pattern a request log row belongs to.

fields.name: run_id
fields.doc: The CI run or deployment request id the marker was posted from.

fields.name: sample_seq
fields.doc: Position of one db.health_sample in its poller's per-boot sequence; consecutive samples have adjacent seqs from one source_id.

fields.name: schema_ver
fields.doc: The registry's content hash, so a reader knows which catalogue the record was written against.

fields.name: sdk_version
fields.doc: The Chalk SDK version inside the host app.

fields.name: seq
fields.doc: The record's position in its source's stream, with no reuse. On a client the outbox stamps it, never the kernel. A client source counts from 0, as the outbox and the delivery ledger do (C3); a server source (the API, SFU and Sync kernels) counts from 1 and has no ledger.

fields.name: service_name
fields.doc: The service a boot or sample belongs to, such as api or sync.

fields.name: service_version
fields.doc: The OpenTelemetry service.version a row was emitted with, projected by the reader.

fields.name: shown_ms
fields.doc: How long a dismissed surface was on screen.

fields.name: source_id
fields.doc: The stream that owns seq. On a client the outbox stamps it with seq. A client starts a new source for each page load and for each Participant it joins as, and only that Participant's credential may write it (C3); a server uses its instance id.

fields.name: space_id
fields.doc: The Space.

fields.name: span_id
fields.doc: The W3C span.

fields.name: started_ms
fields.doc: Unix milliseconds when a deploy or rollback attempt began.

fields.name: status
fields.doc: An HTTP response status code.

fields.name: status_class
fields.doc: The HTTP status class of a request row, so a 5xx marks a failure some finding must explain.

fields.name: stmt_status
fields.doc: Whether pg_stat_statements was readable in this sample.

fields.name: stmt_top
fields.doc: Up to five pg_stat_statements deltas as queryid:calls:total_exec_ms separated by semicolons, largest total_exec_ms first. Never query text.

fields.name: surface_state
fields.doc: Whether a surface was shown or dismissed.

fields.name: sync_connection_id
fields.doc: The Sync websocket.

fields.name: target
fields.doc: The uptime check name a probe ran, such as API readiness.

fields.name: tenant_id
fields.doc: The tenant.

fields.name: tick_status
fields.doc: Whether the edge collector finished a bucket for a host: ok or error(code).

fields.name: to_state
fields.doc: The state after a transition.

fields.name: total_conns
fields.doc: Pool connections open at this sample.

fields.name: trace_id
fields.doc: The W3C trace.

fields.name: trigger
fields.doc: What caused a transition, from the machine's trigger list.

fields.name: ua_class
fields.doc: Whether the request's user agent matched the known-bot list.

fields.name: uptime_status
fields.doc: Whether an uptime probe reached its target: ok, an unexpected HTTP status, or the fetch itself failed.

fields.name: user_id
fields.doc: The tenant's identifier for the person.

fields.name: webhook_delivery_id
fields.doc: The webhook delivery.

reasons.doc: The caller cancelled the operation before it finished.
The Episode reached its time limit and the API ended it. The client failures the end itself caused are expected.
The surge is a deploy's own restart window: edge 502 or 530 with origin 0 or api 503 inside the marker's span, exactly one release.started of the new release, and quiet buckets after.
An error that no classifier named. Counted as unexplained, so a rise is a gap in the catalogue.

events.name: api.http_request
events.doc: The API's per-request log row with its status, route and duration; the request witness for lock waits and post-change failures.

events.name: api.service_version
events.doc: The reader's projection of an API row's OpenTelemetry service.version, one per row and time, so the running release is witnessed continuously. Emitted by the evidence reader, never a program.

events.name: client.call_ended
events.doc: The SDK decided which end screen the call gets. The client kernel records it where the connection chooses the end screen, and the API logs it as a kernel row. An SDK release before the client kernel sent it as an sdk.telemetry row of type call_ended, which the legacy match still reads.

events.name: client.flags_snapshot
events.doc: The full flags map behind the flags_hash a Chalk client kernel stamps on this and every later record, with the client build's release_sha. Logged at boot, at join and whenever the flags change.

events.name: db.health_sample
events.doc: One Postgres health sample from the API's dedicated poller connection: reachability, pool statistics, lock waiters and statement deltas.

events.name: db.media_plane_change
events.doc: The checker's read of one media_plane_changes row: the anchor a media-plane change leaves for release.failures_after_change. Emitted by the evidence reader, never a program.

events.name: edge.collector_tick
events.doc: One edge collector tick per host and bucket: ok proves the bucket was read and a zero count there is real.

events.name: edge.http_rollup
events.doc: One edge rollup row: requests the collector counted for a five-minute UTC bucket by host, path class, edge and origin status, method, content and agent class.

events.name: edge.uptime_check
events.doc: One uptime probe result per cycle: whether the target answered healthy, its HTTP status and the probe duration.

events.name: host.db_reachable
events.doc: The production host collector's per-minute database-unreachable row; the reader projects chalk_alert_value onto db_reach so its claim matches the API sample's.

events.name: host.runtime_health
events.doc: The production host collector's per-minute runtime-health row; the reader projects chalk_alert_value onto origin_reach so its claim matches the uptime probe's.

events.name: obs.clock_jump
events.doc: The client's wall clock stepped, so its clock samples were dropped and clock_epoch moved on.

events.name: obs.flags_snapshot
events.doc: The full flags map behind the flags_hash the kernel stamps on this and every later record. Logged at boot, at join and whenever the flags change.

events.name: release.marker
events.doc: A deploy or rollback marker posted by the release tooling after its result is known: the one CI decision the GitHub record and this row copy.

events.name: release.started
events.doc: One service boot reporting the release it runs and how the previous boot ended. Sync emits it as a zero-length span, which the legacy match reads.

events.name: selftest.admit
events.doc: A self-test decision.

events.name: selftest.banner
events.doc: A self-test surface.

events.name: selftest.note
events.doc: A self-test fact.

events.name: selftest.work
events.doc: A self-test op.

events.name: sync.episode.ended
events.doc: Sync saw the Episode's authoritative end, with the reason the API stored in episodes.end_reason.

events.name: sync.service_version
events.doc: The reader's projection of a Sync row's OpenTelemetry service.version, one per row and time. Emitted by the evidence reader, never a program.

machines.name: client.connection
machines.doc: The SDK connection state (CONNECTION_STATES in sdks/typescript/client/src/connection/types.ts). Its one writer is transition() in connection/lifecycle.ts.

machines.name: episode.lifecycle
machines.doc: The Episode row's status in Postgres (episodes.status).

facts.name: admission.decision
facts.doc: The API's admission decision for a join attempt. Claim: admitted, or the refusal reason.

facts.name: audio.capture
facts.doc: A rollup of a seat's microphone level before WebRTC over exactly its window. Values: rms_max_dbfs.

facts.name: audio.ingress
facts.doc: A rollup of a seat's audio packets at SFU ingress over exactly its window. Values: packets, voiced.

facts.name: audio.mic_state
facts.doc: Whether a seat's microphone was muted or unmuted, held over a window. Claim: muted or unmuted.

facts.name: board.camera
facts.doc: One move of a viewer's board camera. Claim: what moved it (user_pan, follow, fit and so on).

facts.name: db.change
facts.doc: One media_plane_changes row read at check time: a media-plane change anchor, including the DB kill switch.

facts.name: db.lock
facts.doc: chalk-api backends waiting on a lock and the blocking session's identity, from the poller's pg_stat_activity and pg_blocking_pids read.

facts.name: db.pool
facts.doc: The API's Postgres pool state in one sample: fullness and acquire deltas from pgxpool Stat, plus the server-side chalk-api session counts.

facts.name: db.reachable
facts.doc: Whether Postgres could be reached, claimed by the API's health sample over its own connection and by the host collector's independent read. Claim vocabulary for both: 0 reachable, 1 unreachable, so a contradiction prints as a disagree line.

facts.name: edge.bucket
facts.doc: One edge rollup row over a five-minute bucket: request counts by host, path class, edge status, origin status, method, content and agent class.

facts.name: edge.host_runtime
facts.doc: The host collector's runtime-health reason for a host, the detail that names a failed API process or tunnel.

facts.name: edge.origin_up
facts.doc: Whether the origin answers the edge, claimed by the uptime probes and by the host collector's runtime-health row. Claim vocabulary for both: 0 up, 1 down or unhealthy, so a contradiction prints as a disagree line.

facts.name: edge.tick
facts.doc: One collector tick per host and bucket; an ok tick proves the bucket was really read, so a zero count there is a measured zero.

facts.name: end.client_screen
facts.doc: The end screen a client chose for its call. Claim: the client's end reason. A failure screen (connection lost, join failed) is a failure some finding must explain.

facts.name: end.episode
facts.doc: The Episode's authoritative end. Claim: the end reason.

facts.name: flags.boot
facts.doc: One service boot, keyed by its host_boot_id, so a flags snapshot and a release marker can be placed in the same boot's window.

facts.name: flags.snapshot
facts.doc: One boot's full flags snapshot and its flags_hash; two boots of the same service with different hashes are a config change.

facts.name: join.leave
facts.doc: A seat's leave request and its outcome. A failed leave is a failure every finding must account for.

facts.name: recording.job_state
facts.doc: The terminal state of a post-call job, read from its Postgres row. Claim: succeeded or the failure state.

facts.name: release.client
facts.doc: The release_sha a Chalk web client's kernel stamped on a boot or join record, the witness for a Pages deploy that did not take.

facts.name: release.marker
facts.doc: A deploy or rollback marker for one component: the authoritative release change record.

facts.name: release.request
facts.doc: One API request and its status; a 5xx is a failure some finding must explain.

facts.name: release.running
facts.doc: The release a service is actually running, from its rows' service.version, so a version other than the deployed release proves the deploy did not take.

facts.name: report.problem
facts.doc: A problem report a person filed, from a seat or from outside the call. Claim: the report kind.

symptoms.doc: The client lost its connection and did not recover within the recovery window.
A join attempt never got an admission decision, so the person waited on a screen that never resolved.

witnesses.query: axiom chalk-logs | where client_session_id == '{attempt}' and kind == 'decision' and name in ('invite.resolve', 'admission.decided')
witnesses.doc: The decision that admits or refuses the attempt.

symptoms.doc: The Participant can't hear someone who is speaking.
The Participant's microphone is on but others can't hear them.

witnesses.query: axiom chalk-logs | where episode_id == '{episode}' and participant_id == '{participant}' and event == 'sdk.mic_state' | where _time between (datetime({from}) .. datetime({to}))
witnesses.doc: When the seat's microphone was unmuted.

witnesses.query: axiom chalk-logs | where episode_id == '{episode}' and participant_id == '{participant}' and event == 'sfu.media.ingress' and media_kind == 'audio' | where _time between (datetime({from}) .. datetime({to}))
witnesses.doc: Whether voiced packets reached the SFU while it was unmuted.
The capture level, which attributes a silent ingress to a client hop.

symptoms.doc: A follower's whiteboard view jumped away from what the person they follow is looking at.

witnesses.doc: Every camera move, so a burst of automatic moves shows.

symptoms.doc: API database connections wait on a lock another session holds, so writes stall.

witnesses.doc: The poller's lock waiters and blocker identity.
Support only: request durations while waiters hold.

symptoms.doc: Every pool connection is busy and API requests queue for one or time out waiting.

witnesses.doc: The poller's per-sample pool Stat deltas and server-side session counts.

symptoms.doc: The API cannot open or ping Postgres; a dead database can't look like an empty day.

witnesses.query: axiom $CHALK_INFRA_DATASET | where env == '{environment}' and (name == 'db.health_sample' or chalk_alert_rule == 'database-unreachable')
witnesses.doc: The API's own sample and the host collector's independent minute row; both are required.

symptoms.doc: Static asset requests fail at the edge (404 or 5xx); a page whose bundle is missing can't report itself.

witnesses.doc: Per-bucket asset-class failures.
Buckets count only where an ok tick exists for that host.
A web marker under two hours old shapes the hypothesis toward a stale tab.

symptoms.doc: Cloudflare answers 5xx because the origin is down or unreachable; the host collector and uptime probes say where the break is.

witnesses.doc: Per-bucket non-health traffic and edge statuses.
Buckets count only where an ok tick exists for that host.

witnesses.query: axiom $CHALK_INFRA_DATASET | where env == '{environment}' and (name == 'edge.uptime_check' or chalk_alert_rule == 'runtime-health')
witnesses.doc: Uptime probes and the host collector's runtime-health row; a contradiction between them prints as a disagree line.
The runtime-health reason that names the tunnel or the API process.

symptoms.doc: The Episode reached its time limit and ended. Expected, and it claims the client failures the end itself caused.

witnesses.query: axiom chalk-logs | where episode_id == '{episode}' and name == 'sync.episode.ended'
witnesses.doc: The authoritative end Sync saw, with the reason the API stored. A time-limit end has the reason maximum_duration.

symptoms.doc: The Episode ended for an authoritative reason, but the client showed a failure end screen (connection lost or join failed) instead of the Episode-ended screen.
user_words: it said I lost connection when the class ended
the call ended with an error

witnesses.query: axiom chalk-logs | where episode_id == '{episode}' and name == 'sync.episode.ended'
witnesses.doc: The authoritative end and when it happened.

witnesses.query: axiom chalk-logs | where episode_id == '{episode}' and participant_id == '{participant}' and (name == 'client.call_ended' or (event == 'sdk.telemetry' and type == 'call_ended'))
witnesses.doc: The end screen the seat's client chose.

symptoms.doc: A service booted with different config switches and no release marker explains the change.
user_words: someone flipped a flag off deploy

witnesses.query: axiom $CHALK_INFRA_DATASET | where env == '{environment}' and name == 'obs.flags_snapshot' and module == 'api'
witnesses.doc: Each boot's flags map and flags_hash.
Each boot's start record; a boot without a snapshot is itself a gap.
Markers that may explain a changed boot; proven absence makes the change unrecorded.

symptoms.doc: The Participant joined but no media connected, so they neither hear nor are heard.
The call page crashed or rendered an error boundary.
An ended Episode's recording never became ready to watch.

witnesses.query: postgres: select state, updated_at from recording_jobs where id = '{job}'
witnesses.doc: Whether and how the job ended.

symptoms.doc: A Participant who left or dropped could not rejoin an Episode that was still active.
user_words: it won't let me back in

symptoms.doc: API or Sync 5xx surge within 60 minutes after a marker, a media-plane change or a boot config change.

witnesses.doc: Deploy, rollback, auto_rollback and failed markers of every component.

witnesses.query: postgres media_plane_changes | where changed_at >= '{from}' and changed_at <= '{to}'
witnesses.doc: Media-plane changes read at check time, including the DB kill switch.
Edge 5xx per bucket and host, counted only where an ok tick exists; required.

witnesses.query: axiom $CHALK_REQUESTS_DATASET | where env == '{environment}' and event == 'http.request' and status >= 500
witnesses.doc: API request 5xx; counted only where the edge bucket cannot be used, never added to edge counts.
The ok tick that makes a bucket's zero count real.

witnesses.query: axiom $CHALK_INFRA_DATASET | where env == '{environment}' and name == 'obs.flags_snapshot' and module == 'api'
witnesses.doc: Boots whose flags_hash differs from the previous boot are anchors.
Boots for the deploy_restart span and config-change anchors.

symptoms.doc: A component runs, or the Chalk web app reports, a release other than the one the marker deployed.

witnesses.doc: The expected release per component, from deploy and rollback markers.
The release each api or sync row was emitted with.

witnesses.query: axiom $CHALK_LIFECYCLE_DATASET | where env == '{environment}' and name == 'client.flags_snapshot' and module == 'sdk'
witnesses.doc: Client boots reporting the release_sha of the web bundle they loaded; optional because client rows are per seat.

symptoms.doc: The Participant stopped sharing but others still see the share.
user_words: my screen is still being shared

symptoms.doc: A video tile stopped updating while its publisher was still sending.
